The NetBeansFX Layout API provides stable identities and immutable values for product-owned logical areas (ViewArea), physical dock groups (DockGroupSpec) and content-free layout trees (LayoutSpec/LayoutNode) built with LayoutBuilder, including presentations, capacities, capabilities, policy references, styling and lifecycle.
Ids are immutable, namespaced and persistable. Built-in roles/kinds are neutral; products define their own namespaced values. The module contains no JavaFX or runtime behavior.
